players.bio: Alfie Ben May (born 3 July 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Doncaster Rovers, on loan from EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. May began his career with Billericay Town. He then played for Corinthian and Chatham Town, before joining Bromley on a dual-registration basis in January 2014.
Bayley McCann is a 20-year-old professional footballer from Northern Ireland who plays as a versatile left-back and midfielder for Doncaster Rovers F.C. in EFL League One.
Brandon Alex Graham Hanlan (born 31 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Darren Robert Russell Robinson is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Francis Okereke Okoronkwo is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Doncaster Rovers.
George Broadbent (born 30 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Doncaster Rovers.

Grant Samuel McCann (born 15 April 1980) is a Northern Irish professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder in the Football League. He is the manager of EFL League Two club Doncaster Rovers. Born in Belfast, McCann played in the Distillery youth system from 1995 until signing for the West Ham United Academy of Football in 1996, where he started his professional career.
Hakeeb Adeola Abiola Ayinde Adelakun (born 11 June 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a Right Winger .

Harry Louis Clifton (born 12 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder and winger for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers. Club career Grimsby Town Clifton joined Grimsby Town as an under-10 and progressed through the club's youth system. Clifton signed his first professional contract in July 2015.
Isaac Hutchinson is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Jack Christopher Senior (born 13 January 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.

James Steven Collins is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers on loan from EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Starting his career at Aston Villa, he did not break through to the first team and has since represented a number of teams in the English Football League and the Scottish Premiership.
James Coppinger (born 18 January 1981) is an English former professional footballer who played as an attacking midfielder who is currently a first-team coach at Doncaster Rovers.
James Andrew Husband is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or a centre-back for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Jamie Michael Sterry (born 21 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays for Doncaster Rovers.

John-Alan "Jay" McGrath (born 15 April 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers. Mainly a centre-back, he can also be deployed as a left-back.
Jordan Reece Thomas is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.

Josh Clarke (born 28 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One side Doncaster Rovers, on loan from Partick Thistle. A former youth international for England, Sweden and the Republic of Ireland, Clarke is currently a senior international for Northern Ireland.

Leon Ayinde (born 5 September 2004) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers. He is also a prominent Republic of Ireland U21 international.
Matthew Joe Pearson (born 3 August 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or a midfielder for Doncaster Rovers .

Neill Byrne is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers. Career Early career Byrne was born in Portmarnock, Ireland. He started his career with Irish sides Portmarnock and Belvedere before joining the Nottingham Forest Youth Academy at the age of 14.
Owen John Edward Bailey (born 22 January 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Robbie Gotts (born 9 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers, as a midfielder or right-back.
Seán Patrick Grehan (born 8 January 2004) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for League One club Doncaster Rovers. He is a Republic of Ireland youth international.
Tom Nixon (born 25 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.

Tommi Dylan Brooklyn O'Reilly (born 15 December 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa.
Tommy James Simkin is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers on loan from EFL Championship club Stoke City.
